# KovaLab

> A software solutions studio in Nairobi, Kenya, building fast websites and web apps for businesses across East Africa. Websites are built for how East African customers actually transact: M-Pesa, Paystack, and WhatsApp checkout are first-class options, not afterthoughts.

## Services
- [Web development](https://kovalab.co.ke/services/web-development): fast, professional websites and web applications
- [UI/UX design](https://kovalab.co.ke/services/ui-ux-design): interfaces built for how customers actually decide
- [Data and analytics](https://kovalab.co.ke/services/data-analytics): tracking, dashboards, and reporting that answer real questions

## Key pages
- [About](https://kovalab.co.ke/about): the studio and how it works
- [Work / portfolio](https://kovalab.co.ke/work): case studies from real clients
- [Get a quote](https://kovalab.co.ke/quote): published pricing in Kenyan shillings, no sales call required to see cost
- [Contact](https://kovalab.co.ke/contact): book a free call or reach out directly

## Blog
- [Notes from the studio](https://kovalab.co.ke/blog): practical writing on websites, payments, and analytics for East African businesses
